checks: Landing Get Started opens interactive onboarding with local assets

Required outcome, raw input persistence and demo mode are clear
A generation failure retains the brief and retries with the same request ID
Review enforces a coordinator, validates unique names and records selected coworkers
Review edits survive Back to setup, return to review and reload
An activation error preserves every review edit and excluded role

The completion screen survives refresh and remains usable on mobile
First mission handoff loads the new organization and the live 3D roster
Template loading errors offer an immediate retry without losing customization
All five templates can be customized, reviewed and activated in the browser
Switching start paths preserves shared input and template choice across reloads
A changed brief retried after failure generates a new draft instead of returning the old one
Save and exit preserves URL parameters, and Continue setup restores the draft
Setup and review stay within the viewport at phone, tablet and desktop widths
Storage restrictions do not prevent setup and reduced motion stops decorative animation
AI Settings offers a visible return path and preserves the setup draft
An actual request timeout keeps the brief and allows a safe draft retry
Unavailable 3D graphics never leave a blocking loading screen after onboarding
A draft removed from the server can be recreated from the saved brief

No uncaught browser errors across all onboarding scenarios
